title: [bug] lichen-node rfc6554_route_crosses_two_relays_and_restores_packet fails on HEAD after worker7 SRH validation rewrite
description: Deterministic failure on HEAD (worker6 checkout, clean tree): lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:443 unwrap on Err(InvalidSourceRoute) at the second relay hop of advance_rpl_source_route. Introduced by worker7 sync commit acffbe4365 which rewrote advance_rpl_source_route with SourceRouteView/RoutingHeaderSurvey policy mirroring the C router (router.c). The test's hop/sender data (relay_one[8..] as sender_iid at the middle hop) no longer satisfies the new policy. Discovered while running lichen-node tests to validate the local oscore observe port (bead 9liz work); NOT caused by it (workspace diff was Cargo.toml patch path only). Likely within the in-progress project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix fix scope (router-level SRH validation + aligned address grid); coordinate with worker7: either the test data must be updated to grid-valid addresses, or the new validation rejects a legitimate middle-hop case (sender_iid expectation changed from previous-hop to upstream-of-sender).
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-mpct (double-created when the first create's JSON output was lost in a pipe).
